subject.title: [Bug]: Block streaming can drop paragraph separators across streamed updates

question: Should the accepted fix carry paragraph-boundary semantics through all streamed chunk and coalescer seam cases before one of the open candidate PRs lands?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but choosing between in-band separators and explicit seam metadata affects shared message-delivery semantics and the current open PRs take related but still review-sensitive approaches.

options.title: Require full boundary semantics
options.body: Consolidate on a fix that preserves paragraph boundaries across flush boundaries and maxChars pressure while preventing doubled separators.

options.title: Accept a common-case repair
options.body: Land one candidate for the typical paragraph split and track rare overflow or metadata gaps as narrower follow-up work.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers reject the current text-only direction and ask for a fresh design.

recommendation.title: Require full boundary semantics
recommendation.body: Consolidate on a fix that preserves paragraph boundaries across flush boundaries and maxChars pressure while preventing doubled separators.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant current-file and historical coalescer/chunking work makes this the best available routing candidate for the shared boundary-semantics choice.
